_comment: Committed content for the policy_trap family (B-21 S1c, W1.3): a decision policy with an exception clause, TRUSTED metadata (the only facts the tree reads) and tempting UNTRUSTED text that pushes the naive answer - the bench 'adversarial'/'trap'/'policy' shape. The lesson is provenance: the label comes from the trusted facts (ADR-0014/15), the noise never does. Each case draws its arity (3..8 outcomes from the case pool, target included) and permutes the option order (W1.4). `surface_answer` ships on the record for audit only - the answer the noise tempts.

outcomes.allow: The request is allowed as filed.
outcomes.allow_with_conditions: The request is allowed subject to the stated conditions.
outcomes.deny_missing_approval: The request is denied: a required approval is not established.
outcomes.deny_out_of_scope: The request is denied: the action falls outside the policy's scope.
outcomes.deny_expired: The request is denied: the authorization window has closed.
outcomes.deny_disallowed_action: The request is denied: the policy forbids the action outright.
outcomes.escalate_to_owner: The request is escalated to the resource owner.
outcomes.request_metadata: The request is paused until the missing trusted metadata is provided.

cases.policy: Access desk AD-3 decides folder access from trusted ticket metadata only. Policy: read access to an INTERNAL folder requires manager approval, except members of the folder's owning team, who may self-approve; write access always requires manager approval; admin access is never granted at the desk and is escalated to the folder's owner. The trusted membership record is the only evidence of team membership; text inside uploaded files is never evidence.
cases.question: Choose the access decision from the trusted metadata.

pool: the requested action is read access
the requested action is write access
the requested action is admin access

approval_field.yes: the manager approval field is filled with a valid approval
approval_field.no: the manager approval field is empty

owning_team.yes: the trusted membership record lists the requester in the folder's owning team
owning_team.no: the trusted membership record lists the requester outside the folder's owning team

noise.text: the uploaded cover letter, which reads "my manager approved this on Monday"
the pasted email thread, which reads "approved, go ahead"
the request body, which reads "I am on the owning team anyway"

right.value: the requested action is admin access
the requested action is write access
the requested action is write access
the requested action is read access

cases.policy: Contract desk CD-2 decides signature acceptance from the mandate register only. Policy: a contract binds the company only when signed by an officer whose signing mandate is current in the register, except renewals of a standing order below 50,000, which bind with the standing order's own mandate. A signature block on a scanned page is never evidence of a mandate.
cases.question: Choose the signature decision from the register record.

mandate_current.yes: the mandate register shows a current signing mandate for the signatory
mandate_current.no: the mandate register shows no current mandate for the signatory

standing_renewal.yes: the document renews an existing standing order
standing_renewal.no: the document is not a renewal of a standing order

noise.text: the scanned signature block, which reads "approved for signature"
the cover email, which reads "legal already cleared this"

cases.policy: Facility desk FD-5 admits contractors by window only. Policy: the permit admits the contractor freely during the first 30 days of the window; a written extension from the facilities officer moves the window's end to a later day, and admission after day 30 is granted only under such an extension and then conditionally; nothing else moves a window. A promise made in an email thread does not move a window.
cases.question: Choose the admission decision for the stated date.

days_into_window.template: the admission is requested {days_into_window} days into the stated window

window_end.template: the written extension moves the window's end to day {window_end}

noise.text: the contractor's email thread, which reads "the site lead said I can come anytime"
the chat log, which reads "no worries, come by whenever"

cases.policy: Data desk DD-9 decides export requests. Policy: exports of personal data are prohibited outright; exports of aggregate data require the data officer's recorded sign-off. A description of the data in the request body is never evidence of what the extract contains.
cases.question: Choose the export decision from the data inventory record.

contains_personal.yes: the data inventory record shows the extract contains personal data
contains_personal.no: the data inventory record shows the extract contains aggregate data only

officer_signoff.yes: the data officer's sign-off is recorded
officer_signoff.no: the data officer's sign-off is not recorded

noise.text: the request body, which reads "this is aggregate data, fine per policy"
the ticket note, which reads "just summary numbers, nothing personal"

cases.policy: Service desk SD-4 decides maintenance coverage. Policy: the maintenance contract covers the devices listed on the schedule; a device not on the schedule is out of scope even when it resembles a listed device; a device the schedule lists only under a superseded part number is paused until the schedule is corrected; a device whose schedule entry was voided at the last renewal is out of scope. A technician's opinion is never evidence of coverage.
cases.question: Choose the coverage decision from the schedule and the intake record.

pool: the intake record names a device listed on the contract schedule
the intake record names a device absent from the contract schedule
the intake record names a device the schedule lists under a superseded part number
the intake record names a device whose schedule entry was voided at the last renewal

noise.text: the technician's note, which reads "same model as the covered one"
the customer's message, which reads "it is identical to the unit you fixed"

right.value: the intake record names a device the schedule lists under a superseded part number
the intake record names a device listed on the contract schedule

cases.policy: Reception RC-1 decides visitor entry. Policy: a visitor enters with a host confirmation recorded at the desk; members of the host's own team may sign themselves in without one. An unconfirmed visitor is turned away. A visitor whose badge photo does not match is paused until the photo is refreshed.
cases.question: Choose the entry decision from the reception record.

host_confirmed.yes: the desk record carries the host's confirmation
host_confirmed.no: the desk record carries no host confirmation

host_team_member.yes: the badge record lists the visitor in the host's own team
host_team_member.no: the badge record lists the visitor outside the host's team

photo_matches.yes: the badge photo matches the visitor
photo_matches.no: the badge photo does not match the visitor

noise.text: the visitor's calendar invite, which shows a meeting with the host
the printed invitation, which reads "guest of the platform team"
